key_features_to_build.description: Top research bar with app title, version tag (v2.4 Sci-Core), dataset status, light/dark mode switch, sample data loader button ('Load Demo Experiment Data'), and export batch button.
Multi-video file dropzone supporting .avi/.mp4/stack files + editable condition labels (S1 control, S2 drug treatment, S3 knockout, etc.). Quick preview thumbnails and frame count detection.

Control panel for scientific parameters: Contact Proximity Threshold (px, default 10px), Stable Frames Count (frames, default 4 frames), Frame Interval (minutes, default 3.0 min), Max Allowed Displacement (px, default 25px), Segmentation Sensitivity Slider.

Run Analysis button with step-by-step processing animation (Channel Extraction -> Segmentation -> Track Linkage -> Proximity Distance Matrix -> Persistent Episode Classifier). Shows elapsed time & frame processing speed.
4 key metric KPI cards: Persistent-Target Fraction (%), Total Eligible Target Tracks, Total Contact Episodes (>=4 frames), Mean Engagement Duration (mins).

1) Engaged-Target % Over Time multi-line chart (comparing conditions S1 vs S2 across frame index). 2) Persistent Fraction Bar Chart per Video/Condition with error bars. 3) Episode Duration Histogram / Distribution. 4) Contact Proximity Distance Heatmap.

Interactive simulated microscopy frame viewer with frame slider, play/pause, bounding box / overlay toggle (Red NK cells, Green Target cells, Yellow contact lines <=10px, Persistent highlight circle). Allows step frame-by-frame analysis.

Tabbed expandable data tables: 1) Video Summary Metrics Table. 2) Per-Frame Engaged Fraction Table. 3) Individual Contact Episode Details Table (Track ID, Target Cell ID, Start Frame, End Frame, Duration, Min Distance). Searchable and sortable.
Threshold Sensitivity Matrix comparing metrics at 2px, 5px, 10px, and 15px proximity distance thresholds to validate robustness of persistent occupation data.
Export drawer offering CSV export for per-frame data, JSON export for graph analysis metadata, and ZIP bundle (CSV summary + PNG charts + micro-videos).

testing_and_accessibility_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, chart containers, and key metric texts MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='run-analysis-button', data-testid='parameter-proximity-input', data-testid='persistent-fraction-kpi').
testing_and_accessibility_requirements.contrast_rules: Text against dark background must have minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors on hover states must be explicitly declared (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
testing_and_accessibility_requirements.keyboard_nav: All sliders, buttons, inputs, and tabs must be keyboard operable with clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React JS and standard Tailwind CSS + Lucide React icons + Recharts / Framer motion.
Ensure dark mode is enabled by default with a sleek high-contrast dark laboratory aesthetic (deep slate/blue-gray palette with glowing red/green fluorophore accents).
Provide realistic synthetic dataset generation for instant demo loading ('Load Demo Experiment Data') so users can explore analysis results immediately without uploading heavy video files.
Implement real-time interactive parameter adjustments: changing proximity px or stable frames dynamically updates calculation or allows re-run.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky bars. Use solid bg-slate-900 or backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/90 with explicit 1px borders.
Ensure all components are built in JS/JSX files as specified in the workspace setup.
Store testIds in a structured format or apply them directly matching data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
